# Stacked Totems

[![Download on Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Modrinth-1bd96a?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/totem-stacker)

## Overview
This datapack adds a custom crafting recipe that allows players to bundle **9 Totems** into a single stack.

This makes them **easier to store** and **helps protect** them in **PvP** and other **dangerous situations**.
